preconditions.description: The length of the array a is between 3 and 10^5.
Each element in the array a is a positive integer.

postconditions.description: The output must be either 'YES' or 'NO' indicating whether it is possible to make all elements equal.
If the output is 'YES', then the number of operations m must be between 0 and n.

postconditions.expression: if output == 'YES': all(a_i == a_j for i, j in operations)
postconditions.description: If the output is 'YES', then after performing the operations, all elements in the array must be equal.
If the output is 'NO', then the number of operations m must be -1.
